limits: Counts include no-ops and conservative declines.

The initial differential run found an identity-shadow edge mismatch caused by substituting transparent layer padding for an unknown source-image boundary. Boundary metadata was preserved and a native regression added.
This route requires integral translation, in-bounds integral source/destination rectangles of equal size, full paint alpha and premultiplied sRGB input.
General source-image spatial filtering, drop-shadow chains, rotated layers, SVG graphs, tiled surfaces and native browser bridges remain open.
The browser still links Skia; no Skia-free browser compile/link/run is claimed.
